policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: Qere reads plural חֳמַרְמְרוּ, ketiv singular חמרמרה; both agree with פָּנַי (plural form, singular sense). ASV 'My face is red' renders the English singular noun 'face' with a singular verb regardless of Hebrew number, and no textual note is mapped to this unit, so the English does not distinguish the readings. Base qere fallback retained.
